'''Suspected Activities Considered Against the Interests and/or Benefit of Alliance Operations and/or Security''' was a document used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to keep track of potential threats to the Alliance. The information contained in [[Datafile Sub-J]] (sourcefile 56211217.KXYR.170649) was used by the [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] to fill out the "Suspected or Potential Threat" section of [[SecuriDex]]s on individuals of interest to the Alliance.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
